title: Allowance for ITE and Polytechnic Student Interns
what_it_is: Allowance for ITE and Polytechnic Student Interns

sections.label: Internship allowance coverage for students
sections.summary: 93.5% of Polytechnic and ITE interns receive an allowance, up from 90.9% in 2014, though some still do not due to company-specific policies.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Through the efforts of the Polytechnics and ITEs, currently, 93.5% of Polytechnic and ITE students who go on internships receive an allowance, up from 90.9% in 2014.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: While we have seen much stronger support for internship allowance in certain sectors, such as social work and nursing, there are still some interns from a variety of courses who do not receive an internship allowance, due to company-specific policies.

sections.label: Financial assistance and internship support
sections.summary: Institutions run financial assistance schemes, Polytechnics and ITEs work with companies to raise allowance coverage, and Singapore Polytechnic has a Needy Fund.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: For students who are in need of assistance to cover daily expenses, our institutions administer financial assistance schemes which they can tap on.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: In fact, the Polytechnics and ITEs are working with the companies to see how we can increase the percentage of internships that provide an allowance.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: For example, Singapore Polytechnic has a Needy Fund to support students.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: The Polytechnics and ITEs will also look at how we can further assist our students whenever they need help, including the period during their internship.

sentences.speaker: Ms Chia Yong Yong (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Would the Ministry be looking at how more resources can be placed to help students with special needs find internship places?
